versions.subject: feat: new rules `Linux Package Uninstall` (#4098)
versions.detection:
selection_yum:
    Image|endswith: '/yum'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'erase'
        - 'remove'
selection_apt:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/apt'
        - '/apt-get'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'remove'
        - 'purge'
selection_dpkg:
    Image|endswith: '/dpkg'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '--remove '
        - ' -r '
selection_rpm:
    Image|endswith: '/rpm'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -e '
condition: 1 of selection_*
versions.spl: (Image="*/yum" CommandLine IN ("*erase*", "*remove*")) OR (Image IN ("*/apt", "*/apt-get") CommandLine IN ("*remove*", "*purge*")) OR (Image="*/dpkg" CommandLine IN ("*--remove *", "* -r *")) OR (Image="*/rpm" CommandLine="* -e *")
